scope: The action-24 request called AV configuration in the service source is audio task 41 bank selection, not display, graphics or recordcontrol mode switching.

request.service_pair: Configuration selector zero yields [0x81,0]; every nonzero byte yields [0x80,0].
request.db5698: Compares first word to 0x80, passes the resulting boolean and unchanged second word to 0x006e4c64.
request.owned_cutover: AvConfigurationRuntime calls the existing AudioZoomActor SelectBank request directly. It does not retain a second task-41 engine or transport queue. One service action owns at most one deferred bank request.

dispatch.phases_2_4_8: 0x006e9808 stores bank at 0x008fc768 and publishes event 0x0816 with request word 1 immediately.
dispatch.phases_5_11: 0x006e984c publishes immediately for the current bank. A changed bank selects root 0x007d1d58 for alternate or 0x007d1538 for primary, stores the bank and context, saves the phase and enters phase 13.
dispatch.phase_12: 0x006e9390 rejects; the canonical actor exposes Released and returns NotInitialized.
dispatch.phase_0: The request wrappers do not check phase before queue publication. The worker dispatch rejects phase zero through its phase-minus-one range check. Native bank admission exposes this cold state as Released rather than deferring forever.
dispatch.remaining_valid_phases: Phases 1, 3, 6, 7, 9, 10 and 13 dispatch 0x006e9e24 and defer queue 2. The owned service request remains queued until canonical actor admission becomes available; resume performs admission without ticking the executor.

completion.stock: 0x006e97c0 posts event 0x0816 with context at 0x008fc774 and restores phase from 0x008fc778.
completion.actual_publication_owner: Power audio callbacks own terminal 0x006e97c0 through AudioAction::BankComplete6e97c0 and the audio_bank_residue.S bridge. Its backed Rust provider uses shutdown::post_application_record with NativeShutdownRtos, UiEvents from runtime 0x009134f8 and the full 76-byte record, then reloads and restores the saved phase. No AV acknowledgement callback is installed.
completion.immediate_publication_owner: Canonical Power AudioAction::BankNotify and BankNotifyUnchanged preserve the authenticated immediate-path frame suffixes through audio_bank_residue.S and publish 0x0816/context zero without changing phase. AudioZoomActor invokes the corresponding owned action before reporting immediate completion.
completion.owned_observation: AvConfigurationRuntime polls only the matching canonical AudioZoomActor request generation. Immediate selection or completed canonical executor work yields Completion::Complete. Cancellation, timeout and failure remain distinct terminal outcomes.
completion.service_wait: service_update_wait_pending accepts 0x0816, 0x0901 and 0x090a, ignores selected other events, and returns -255 on wait failure or other 0x09xx events. The bank provider's actual success is 0x0816; unrelated events do not complete the owned request generation.
completion.audio_admission: Only Completion::Complete admits the parent's NativeVendorAudio::begin_capture. A mode request failure rejects action 24 without writing its result configuration key. Duration validation and actual capture execution belong to the audio owner.

canonical_cpu_providers.audio_zoom_actor: Bank phase admission, native worker bank fields, immediate/current-bank completion, executor root selection, generation identity and terminal results.
canonical_cpu_providers.power_audio_release: Executor scheduling, timer-driven actions, codec/resource programming, cancellation, actual terminal notification and phase restoration.
canonical_cpu_providers.power_application_fanout: Canonical application record construction, actual sender selection and queue-1/queue-7 routing.
canonical_cpu_providers.vendor_audio_cpu: Exclusive NativeVendorAudio codec_domain plus actual capture resources, codec setup and DMA.
canonical_cpu_providers.vendor_protocol_join: Action-24 configuration reads, AV resume and capture admission under the same audio domain lock, final service result publication, module and build registration.

cancellation: Queued requests are removed before admission. Admitted requests cancel their exact canonical executor generation. A cancelled result remains terminal and cannot later become successful.

tests.fixture: Synthetic executor memory uses a two-tick OutputOff node. It exercises provider-visible admission and effect timing without copying firmware or pretending to validate stock codec programs.
behaviors: active changed-bank waits for an actual executor effect
poll does not advance the shared executor
cancelled active request cannot execute late

verification: Source-only. Pinned function extents were matched to the owner-supplied images and bank handlers were disassembled. No build, test, linter, formatter, native execution, SDK, camera or USB operation was run. Integration owner verifies the combined source cutover.
